use IO.Std.write_line

strip_comment(line: string, markers: char[]) -> string is
    let cut mut = line.length

    for marker in markers do
        let index = line.index_of(marker)

        if index >= 0 /\ index < cut then
            cut = index
        fi
    od

    line[0..cut].trim()
si

let markers = ['#', ';']

write_line(strip_comment("apples, pears # and bananas", markers))
write_line(strip_comment("apples, pears ; and bananas", markers))
